divergence: All three runs failed, in different ways. All listed the store and then matter folders. T0 searched file names and scanned, then read one closing document from each of 16 matters it picked and left out three matters its own outputs had listed (surfaced-not-opened at the reading stage); it also counted out-of-scope disputes. T1 read almost every needed matter but its answer paired matter numbers with other matters' parties, amounts and payment direction, dropped one read matter and counted out-of-scope disputes (all at the write stage). T2's first content scan printed about 10M chars and the run ended by context overflow. The reviews flagged unopened matters and scope only generically; the scope flag was not acted on in T0 or T1.
